name: [🚗 DRIVE-THRU] Burger Game 🍔
desc:
🍔 Welcome to Burger Game, the ultimate cooking and kitchen chaos simulator!
🎉 More updates coming soon!

[ How to Play ]
• Customers arrive during the daytime!
• Accept customer orders from the order board!
• Use the ingredient bar and meat grillers to build each burger!
• Serve customers their burgers to earn money!
• Don’t go bankrupt!

👨‍🍳 Step into the role of a busy chef! Cook burgers, serve customers, and manage your own fast-food restaurant.
🔥 Work the kitchen, build perfect burgers, and survive the diner rush for max profits!
👥 Play solo or team up with friends to run the best cooking operation in town.

🐦 Follow us on X for secret codes and updates!
💬 Join our community server to meet other players and give feedback to the developers!
💎 Roblox Premium? Get +25% bonus earnings every shift!

🚧 Still in early development! More features are on the way, so stay tuned!
